page.layout: One page of text, single column, full width. Running head at top with page number at top right. Below the text: a centred heading "FINIS" and a printed ornament (woodcut-style decoration, not text). A digitiser's stamp at the bottom right is ignored.

main_text.l: stravimus, antiquior militia numero Equitum differebat ab ea
quæ Polybiano ævo obtinebat, ita quidem ut legioni adjecti fue-
rint super priorem ducentorum numerum, centum equites alii,
& in universum trecenti essent. Deinde rationem seligendi in
utraque militia diversam fuisse etiam ex superioribus cum abunde
constet, finem nunc imponemus huic tractationi.

page.notes: The printed ornament below FINIS is a decorative woodcut, not transcribed. The stamp "Aol 146277l" and watermark-like text at the bottom right are a digitiser's/library marking and are omitted. The running head reads "DE RE MILITARI ROMAN." with the page number 243 at the right.
